name: Zola Nkomo
bio:
Zola Nkomo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during her time working at a shipping company handling international freight. Intrigued by the complex logistics of transporting racing equipment across continents, she transitioned into the motorsport world, initially managing inventory for a small rally team. Her meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving skills quickly earned her recognition, and she moved up the ranks, gaining experience with various racing disciplines. Now at Walkinshaw Andretti United, Zola is responsible for ensuring the seamless flow of parts, equipment, and personnel to race events, working closely with engineers and mechanics to anticipate their needs. 

Zola's approach is rooted in preparation and clear communication. She thrives under pressure, using her calm demeanor to de-escalate tense situations and find creative solutions to logistical challenges. What sets Zola apart is her ability to balance a pragmatic approach with a willingness to embrace new technologies and strategies, constantly seeking ways to improve efficiency and reduce costs.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped natural hair with subtle grey streaks near the temples.
physical.description: Zola is a woman of average height with a warm, approachable face framed by her close-cropped hair.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with color-coded lists.
Has a habit of double-checking every shipment manifest, even when she knows it's correct.
Insists on using a specific type of high-visibility tape for marking equipment cases.
